items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: He'd come over to my place and we'd reminisce about the old Octavia

ctx.x: Tony was the trumpet. Tony, Tony.

Cornette Tony. The Cornette player had a bent mouthpiece because he'd hold his horn down. And he'd hold his handkerchief because he'd sweat, he wasn't coughing off a little. And he'd put the horn out the window. The bandstand was here and the window was here for the first tune. And the guy hit the cymbal, bang! And we used to call him Monk. Abbey Brunis, the drum player, his brother Moon, a monk, whatever you want to call him. He'd come over to my place and we'd reminisce about the old Octavia and he'd say,
Yeah, the Machado on the corner and stick it out the window.
